acceptanceCriteria: A test proves an unlisted environment variable never reaches the runner.
The report digest changes when any bound input digest changes.
Every verdict maps to exactly one documented exit code, with tests.
Receipt bytes are retained or the report reads NOT_RETAINED with a reason.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Verified: internal/jstestprovider/external.go:182 passes os.Environ(); prove.go:345 keeps only the receipt digest; cmd/corvint-test/main.go:105-128 exits 0 whatever the verdict; the report does not bind compile, catalog and obligation digests. Per CCE-V0-021..023: an optional environment block with a digest-pinned serve command per revision, an allowlisted environment, loopback-only egress, receipt bytes retained or NOT_RETAINED, the prove report binding compile/catalog/obligations digests, unknown spans, overall state and scenario digests, and a closed exit-code table.
title: CCE prove: environment block, run isolation, retained receipts, bound report and exit codes
